risks.risk: Condition/defects not visible: shutter count, sensor dust/scratches, button/port faults, or internal damage.
risks.proof: A short video of powering on + navigating menus, plus a shutter count screenshot (or EXIF/shutter count tool result) and a close-up of the sensor (f/16 test shot of a blank wall/sky).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not fully tested / possible faults (as-is).

risks.risk: LCD status unknown (screen may be dead, dim, or has lines).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing the LCD clearly displaying menus and playback (not just a dark screen).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: LCD not working or unreliable.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/compatibility: no lens, no battery, no charger, no memory card, no strap.
risks.proof: A full contents photo laid out (battery model, charger, strap, cables, memory card, and any lens/hood if included).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only with no accessories included.

risks.risk: Mount/contacts wear or damage (affects lens mounting and electrical contacts).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens mount and the electrical contacts (front and inside mount).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: mount/contacts may be worn.

risks.risk: Authenticity/parts mismatch (body could be donor/repair unit).
risks.proof: Photo of the camera with the same serial number clearly readable and a matching check via Canon service/serial lookup (or a receipt/verification).

proof_requests: Power-on video showing LCD clearly (menus + playback).
Shutter count proof (screenshot from a shutter count tool) or EXIF showing total actuations.
Sensor check: a test shot of a uniform surface/sky at f/16 plus a close-up of the sensor area.
Clear photo of included items: battery (type/model), charger, strap, memory card, and whether any lens is included.
Close-up of lens mount and electrical contacts.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, but key value drivers (LCD health, shutter count, sensor condition, and what accessories are included) are not verifiable from the images provided. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
